method: PIB releases fetched directly (browser user-agent + redirect-following defeated the 403s) and verified against release text with exact PRIDs; ministry-primary figures from this repo's earlier 9-ministry pass reused where PIB has no newer number; Exim Bank of India's 'India's International Trade and Investment' (May 2026) and CEAT Industry Tracker (June 2026) used as an independent government-institution cross-check. Letter grades are this repo's stated judgment on two axes -- disbursal progress vs. outlay, and delivery of the scheme's own outcome targets -- with the reasoning shown per row.
grade_criteria: A = incentive flowing at scale AND scheme outcome targets met/exceeded; B = real disbursal or commissioned production, partial delivery; C = scheme operating but disbursal thin or outcome data not public; D = disbursal negligible relative to outlay years into the window, or material beneficiary attrition; F = zero disbursal and implementation stalled. Grades are this repo's judgment -- the evidence column is the checkable part.

rows.grade_evidence: Combined pharma-PLI sales Rs 3.19 lakh cr incl. Rs 2.04 lakh cr exports since inception (PRID 2204595); 191 KSMs/DIs/APIs produced in India for the first time; actual investment 237% of commitment. The largest genuine disbursal-to-outlay ratio of any big scheme.

The program's flagship by every outcome metric (PRID 2247771, 1 Apr 2026): investment Rs 17,519cr = 250% of target; production Rs 11.02 lakh cr = 136%; exports Rs 6.21 lakh cr = 127%; smartphones India's #1 export item in CY2025 (Rs 2,62,452cr). Docked from A: MeitY's own Parliament submission shows only 2 of 5 domestic-category mobile applicants performing, and 92% of the jobs target.

GRADE REVISED A- -> B on new Parliament-era data: the disbursal number finally surfaced and it is 0.8% of outlay -- outcomes are real (Penicillin-G back after ~30 years, imports avoided Rs 3,591cr, 27 plants commissioned) but by this card's own criteria a scheme paying 0.8% cannot sit in the A family. The outcome/payout asymmetry now mirrors Steel's.

GRADE REVISED B+ -> B: the gap filled -- 4.6% of outlay disbursed, thin like White Goods. Delivery remains the stronger half: 28 applicants, eligible sales Rs 13,624.52cr incl. Rs 6,425.48cr exports till Dec 2025; 44 products incl. linear accelerators/MRI/CT first-time made in India.

171 approved applications, >Rs 9,200cr invested (PRID 2230621). One of the few schemes actually paying out at scale -- but PIB names not a single beneficiary company (the Britannia/ITC/Nestle names live only on MoFPI's own PDF), an odd opacity for a consumer-facing sector.

Gap filled: ~9.6% of outlay paid through FY25 and accelerating (FY26 RE alone Rs 1,944cr). Sales >6x FY20; exports Rs 21,033cr; 42 named beneficiaries; BSNL indigenous 4G stack deployed. Grade B holds with payout evidence now attached.

Domestic manufacturing 'has commenced' for compressors, motors, copper tubes and LED drivers (PRID 2230621) with 30+ investors named verbatim (Daikin, Voltas, Hindalco, Amber, LG, Blue Star, Dixon, Signify...). 4.5% of outlay disbursed, and DPIIT still publishes no per-company production status.

GRADE REVISED C+ -> B-: the same Parliament reply reveals real delivery -- ~30 GW module + ~10.5 GW cell + ~2 GW ingot-wafer capacity COMMISSIONED against LoAs for 48,337 MW. A designed-zero payout with commissioned capacity is the opposite of ACC's zero (execution failure); the two zeros must not be read alike.
Sector turnover up 7x; 23 provisional beneficiaries (Asteria, Garuda, IdeaForge...). A tiny scheme that broadly did what a tiny scheme could.

~9% of outlay disbursed 4+ years in; incremental sales Rs 13,126cr by 72 companies in FY26-to-Dec -- far off the Rs 2.31 lakh cr trajectory. 8 OEMs DVA-certified for 94 variants (names not published). Tata Motors and Mahindra credited by PIB with 'massive investments in EV production capacity' (PRID 2115609).

Rs 48cr disbursed = 0.8% of outlay -- and PIB discloses 14 of 58 Round-1 projects WITHDREW, a beneficiary-attrition figure the Ministry's own site never states. Rs 20,000cr invested of Rs 27,106cr committed and 9,000 jobs are real, but the incentive mechanism itself is barely functioning.
0.5% of outlay disbursed 4 years in; only 26 of 74 Round-1/2 applicants had commenced production at last ministry count; zero beneficiary names in any PIB release.

Zero incentive disbursed; Ola's 1 GWh (of 40 allocated) still in 'pilot production' since March 2024, 'working toward stabilizing operations for full-scale commercial production' per PIB's own words; one original awardee (Hyundai Global Motors, 20 GWh) exited without the word 'withdrew' ever appearing in a government document.

note: PLI disbursal report card copied from a separate project (india-trade-sector-policy-recommendations), grades and figures are that repo's own PIB-sourced judgment, not re-verified here. scheme_pq_mentions counts Lok Sabha subject lines + Rajya Sabha subject lines/full question text matching scheme-specific keyword patterns (see SCHEME_MAP in compare_pli.py) -- a conservative undercount, since PQs about a scheme don't always name it explicitly.
